summary: Enable all optional CCSP sheets with METRICS_UTILITY_OPTIONAL_CCSP_REPORT_SHEETS='ccsp_summary,managed_nodes,indirectly_managed_nodes,inventory_scope,usage_by_collections,usage_by_roles,usage_by_modules'.
questions: How do I enable all optional sheets in the CCSP report?
What sheets can a CCSP report include?

answer_card.title: Enable all optional CCSP sheets
answer_card.answer_md:
```sh
export METRICS_UTILITY_OPTIONAL_CCSP_REPORT_SHEETS='ccsp_summary,managed_nodes,indirectly_managed_nodes,inventory_scope,usage_by_collections,usage_by_roles,usage_by_modules'
```
Drop names from the list to omit sheets.
